svg.aria-label: Left: a 50-line PR with a clear description, short to read, reviewed in about ten minutes between two meetings and merged today. Right: a 400-line PR titled fix stuff, a wall of lines that needs a 45-minute block to understand, so it sits for three days. Underneath, a reviewer's afternoon of meetings with small gaps: the small PR fits in any gap, the big one fits in none.
svg.text: SMALL PRS MERGE. BIG PRS WAIT
nobody has a 45-minute block. everybody has 10 minutes
the small PR fits in any gap. the big one fits in none.
